title: Goldilocks-curriculum Domain Randomization and Fractal Perlin Noise with Application to Sim2Real Pneumonia Lesion Detection
reasoning: The paper uses the "Goldilocks principle" as a metaphor for finding an optimal task difficulty or "sweet spot" in curriculum learning, which is derived from a children's story. It does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as core components of its research.
